bs_scaling.text: Definition 2.1. Let m be a nonnegative number and E be a vector-field in R^2. We say E belongs to the admissible class A_m if div E = 2 pi (nu - m) and curl E = 0 (2.1) where nu has the form nu = sum_{p in Lambda} delta_p, for some discrete set Lambda in R^2, (2.2) and if nu(B_R)/|B_R| is bounded by a constant independent of R > 1. ... min_{A_m} W = m (min_{A_1} W - (pi/2) log m), (2.4)

bs_thm15.source: L. Betermin and E. Sandier, Renormalized Energy and Asymptotic Expansion of Optimal Logarithmic Energy on the Sphere, arXiv:1404.4485v5 (April 2018)
bs_thm15.text: Theorem 1.5. There exists C != 0 independent of n such that, as n -> +infinity, E_log(n) = (1/2 - log 2) n^2 - (n/2) log n + C n + o(n), C = (1/pi) min_{A_1} W + (log pi)/2 + log 2. Moreover C <= C_BHS where C_BHS is given in (1.5), and equality holds iff min_{A_1} W is achieved for the triangular lattice of density one.

bs_value.text: W(Lambda_1) = pi log pi - (pi/2) log 3 - 3 pi log(Gamma(1/3)) + (3/2) pi log 2 ~ -4.1504128 (the extraction of the combined form is garbled; the expanded sum on this line is unambiguous and equals pi log(2 sqrt(2) pi / (sqrt(3) Gamma(1/3)^3))). ... Therefore Conjecture 1.3 is true if and only if the triangular lattice Lambda_1 is a global minimizer of W among vector-fields in A_1, i.e. min_{A_1} W = W(Lambda_1).
